title: phone_lease: per-app leases, a short self-cleaning whole-phone lease, one serial
objective: Two sessions each drive a different app on their own virtual display at the same time, only phone-wide actions take the whole phone, and a forgotten forced-Doze cannot outlive five minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Package leases on different apps coexist; the same app is exclusive (exit 3).
A whole-phone lease conflicts with every foreign lease in both directions and is clamped to 300 s.
--cleanup commands run exactly once, on release or on expiry, with no holder action needed.
`holds` answers exit 0/1 for this owner and a scope (whole-phone implies every scope); `status --json` lists all live leases.
No caller ever leases a placeholder serial.
phone_deploy.sh and android_ui keep working unchanged.
out_of_scope: phone_deploy virtual-display default, android_ui --display, the raw-adb hook (other session).
verifier: CLI scenario on a temp lease dir; two concurrent phone_vd displays on the real phone; pytest python_pkg/phone_lease 65 passed at 100% branch coverage.
